mentions.name: Virtual Diwali
mentions.description: A browser-based casual game and experience about Indian festivals where players walk through an old neighbourhood down to a river, light 108 oil lamps, set off crackers, and send lanterns into a sky shared by everyone. Includes a lamp that keeps burning per Indian tradition, a rooftop garden that keeps growing, and more missions planned, running without login or ads.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a casual game / experience about Indian festivals as a hobby project. This started as a Diwali night. You can walk through an old neighbourhood down to a river, light 108 oil lamps, set of crackers and send lanterns to a sky that is shared by everyone. It runs in browser without login or any ads.
mentions.author: abhas9
